name: What is a sewage ejector pump and when do I need one?

mainEntity.name: What is a sewage ejector pump and when do I need one?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sewage ejector pump is a specialized pump used to move wastewater from fixtures located below the main sewer line, such as in a basement bathroom or laundry room. It's necessary when gravity alone cannot drain the sewage into the municipal sewer system or a septic tank. You generally need one if you're installing plumbing fixtures in a basement or any area where the drain lines are lower than the main sewer line, ensuring proper waste removal and preventing back-ups. CG Plumbing Solutions can assess your home's layout to determine if an ejector pump is essential for your plumbing needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sewage ejector pump moves wastewater from below the main sewer line. It's needed for basement plumbing or any area where gravity drainage isn't possible.
